description: Post a question to a room and wait for a person to reply. Offer short options when the answer is a choice: they appear as buttons, and the person can also type. Returns answered:false when nobody replies in time; in that case do not assume approval. Call room_wait to keep waiting.

question.description: The question, with the context needed to decide

room.description: Room name (default: the newest open room)

name: room_ask
title: Ask a question in a room and wait
